title: WPSS/1383/2015 of Pushkar Singh Bhandari Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1383 of 2015
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
None
 Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Advocate
i/b Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. BPS Mer, Brief Holder for the
State.
 Having heard learned counsel for
the petitioner as well as on going through
the averments made in the body of
petition, it transpires that the petitioner
was appointed way back in 1991 and
somehow, he could manage his transfer
just in the next year i.e. 1992 in a school
at convenience place where he is working
for last 23 years. Now, with the present
transfer order, he has been sent to
adjacent District Tehri Garhwal from
Rudraprayag against a vacant post.
 The Court is not inclined to interfere
with the impugned transfer order
irrespective of any government policy in
this regard because such policy is to be
dispensed with in case of exigencies.
 The petition fails and is dismissed
at the threshold.
